title: Near-Null Magnetic Fields in Lunar Plant Biology: The First Five Days of Seedling Growth, Multi-Stressor Bioenergetics, and Implications for Artemis Agriculture
description: Review manuscript, data synthesis, and reproducible figure generation pipeline for Life Sciences in Space Research (LSSR). This work evaluates the biological consequences of the Moon's ambient near-null magnetic field (<0.8 nT at Artemis candidate landing sites) during the critical first 5 days of plant growth (0–120 hours). It synthesizes empirical literature across five core concepts: germination capacity, emergence velocity kinetics, cryptochrome-mediated pigment biosynthesis, convergence on the mitochondrial CO2-O2-ROS nexus with spaceflight radiation and exploration atmospheres, and human-plant conserved Alternative Oxidase (AOX) / mitochondrial stress parallels. Includes an operational flight risk-retirement framework for the NASA Artemis III Lunar Effects on Agricultural Flora (LEAF) payload.
